steps.label: Clear to an explicit, empty Custom scene (Custom is a real named preset, not a typo fallback -- see 91_neg_unknown_preset.json)
Custom starts with just its own floor

Add a second floor plane at y=-10 (exercises AddFloor with an explicit height, previously unused by any scenario -- placed below the original y=0 floor, not above the spawn stack, because PlaneBoundary's valid/free region is y >= offset (see PlaneBoundary.h): a floor at y=10 would make everything spawned below it, at y in [5,9], already-embedded solid and get violently ejected upward by the penalty force, not 'fall past' it)
Body count reflects the extra floor
Precondition: sphere 1 (body 2) starts at its added height
Run: the y=-10 floor is below everything, so it's irrelevant -- all 3 spheres/2 boxes fall and land on the original Custom floor at y=0 (~3.2s)
Invariant: all 7 bodies remain (AddFloor/AddSphere/AddBox bodies are never dropped by stepping)
Reset restores the Custom scene exactly as built
Sphere 1's position IS restored by Reset (regression check: AddSphere/AddBox/AddFloor each re-snapshot, see docs/issue/CODEBASE_ISSUES.md 1.4 history)
